sketch:
Observe: SVG grid with heavy nuclei (²³⁵U); a triggering neutron
hits one, which fissions into 2 daughters + ν neutrons (per a
seeded physics fork) — the emitted neutrons then trigger neighbors,
producing a chain reaction. Population counters and time-series of
released Q per fission shown. Student adjusts k (multiplication
factor) via neutron-absorber slider. Experiment: 3 seeded target
power-time-profiles; student sets k. Evaluate: grid hidden, only
power curve; student submits k blind. Wrinkle: same E_l/A hook —
daughters more bound than parent → Q > 0.
